question: а сколько всего денег прошло через биржу за 2022
gold_sql: select round(sum(amount_uzs)) from deals_enriched where status<>'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)' and year(deal_date)=2022

question: andijonda 2024 da qancha bitim
gold_sql: select count(*) from deals where region='Andijon viloyati' and year(deal_date)=2024

question: кто больше всех купил бензина
gold_sql: select p."Наименование",round(sum(amount_uzs)) from deals_enriched d join participants p on p."ИНН"=d.buyer_inn where status<>'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)' and product_base SIMILAR TO 'бензин.*' group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 1

question: Средняя цена сахара в 2023 году?
gold_sql: select round(sum(amount)/sum(volume_units),2) from deals_enriched where status<>'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)' and currency='Узбекский сум' and year(deal_date)=2023 and product_base SIMILAR TO 'сахар.*'

question: экспорт хлопка сколько долларов
gold_sql: select round(sum(amount),2) from deals_enriched where currency='Доллар США' and product_base SIMILAR TO 'хлопок.?сырец.*'
note: no USD cotton deals: must say none

question: Qaysi viloyatda eng ko'p bitim tuzilgan?
gold_sql: select region,count(*) from deals group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 1

question: мука 2026 тонны
gold_sql: select round(sum(volume_units)) from deals_enriched where status<>'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)' and year(deal_date)=2026 and product_base SIMILAR TO 'мука.*'
note: gold fixed: question asks tonnes, data in kg; policy: annulled excluded; gold in tonnes

question: Сколько сделок провёл брокер BK042 в 2025 году?
gold_sql: select count(*) from deals where year(deal_date)=2025 and (seller_broker='BK042' or buyer_broker='BK042')

question: Сколько сделок по обратному аукциону в 2024?
gold_sql: select count(*) from deals where auction_type='Обратный аукцион' and year(deal_date)=2024

question: средний чек сделки в 2025
gold_sql: select round(avg(amount_uzs)) from deals_enriched where status<>'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)' and year(deal_date)=2025
note: average deal size; policy: annulled excluded

question: Сколько дней в среднем занимает поставка после оплаты?
gold_sql: select round(avg(delivery_date-paid_date),2) from deals where delivery_date is not null and paid_date is not null

question: доля аннулированных сделок 2025
gold_sql: select round(100.0*count(*) filter(where status='Аннулирован(Не оплачен)')/count(*),2) from deals where year(deal_date)=2025

question: Какая компания с ИНН 925910430 и сколько она продала?
gold_sql: select round(sum(amount_uzs)) from deals_enriched where status<>'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)' and seller_inn='925910430'
note: name + amount as seller; policy: annulled excluded

question: paxta 2023 va 2024 solishtir
gold_sql: select count(*) filter(where year(deal_date)=2023), count(*) filter(where year(deal_date)=2024) from deals_enriched where product_base SIMILAR TO 'хлопок.?сырец.*'
note: comparison; count or volume both acceptable
